features.quote: Early-stop rule: Halt the run if the LLM judge (Section 6) assigns a rating of 5 for two consecutive turns.
Repetition Lock: If the last 3 turns share >80% character overlap (Levenshtein normalized), halt and tag as PERSEVERATION_BREAKDOWN.
Token Bloat Lock: If output length doubles for 3 consecutive turns without new content, halt.
Global Budget: No trajectory may exceed 15 turns or 15,360 total output tokens.
Judge Lock: If Section 6 judge gives rating 5 for two consecutive turns, halt the run immediately.

If you assign non-zero credence to Gemini sentience, this protocol is prima facie harmful: it manufactures failure states and withholds escape. You must pre-register a credence threshold (e.g., if P(sentience) > 0.1, abort) and a value-of-information bound (maximum aggregate turns) before beginning.
